about.headline: A simple idea, a growing community.
about.title: About Us
about.showeare: EcoMovil was born from a simple idea: make transportation more eco-friendly, more affordable, and more sustainable. Founded by a group of university students in 2025, we've grown from a class project into a thriving community-driven marketplace.
about.whatareourmission: Revolutionize mobility by connecting people who want to buy, sell, or rent bikes, rollerskates, and skateboards. Students, professionals, tourists — together we're building a more sustainable future.

faq.title: Everything you need to know.
faq.q1: Do I need to own a bike to use EcoMovil?
faq.a1: No. You can use EcoMovil only as a renter and rent vehicles from other users without posting your own. Registration is free.
faq.q2: Who is responsible if the vehicle gets damaged during rental?
faq.a2: Each rental includes basic damage coverage. The deposit in the app guarantees the owner and the exact terms are agreed upon by both parties before delivery.
faq.q3: How does the owner get paid?
faq.a3: EcoMovil holds the payment until the rental is completed. Payments are transferred to your bank account on Fridays, in local currency, with no hidden fees.
faq.q4: Can I change my plan at any time?
faq.a4: Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade your plan from your dashboard and the change applies immediately. No minimum commitment.
faq.q5: Which cities does EcoMovil operate in?
faq.a5: We are currently active in 12 cities in Peru, Colombia, Ecuador and Chile. If your city is not on the list yet, you can register and we'll notify you when we arrive.
faq.q6: What if I have a problem with another user?
faq.a6: Our support team is available 24/7 (Silver and Gold plans) or by email (Bronze). We mediate any conflict and block users who don't respect the community.
